subject: general
question: With which game is the CK Nayudu Trophy associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The C.K. Nayudu Trophy is a **prestigious domestic cricket tournament** in India.
 
• It is named After **C.K. Nayudu, India’s first-ever Test cricket captain in 1932.**
 
• **BCCI** is the national governing body for cricket in India** Founded in 1928.**
 
• The **headquarters of BCCI is at Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 **Sport**
 **National Tournaments**
 
 

 Cricket
 Ranji Trophy, Vijay Hazare Trophy, Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, Duleep Trophy, C.K. Nayudu Trophy, Irani Cup, Deodhar trophy
 
 

 Football
 Santosh Trophy, Indian Super League (ISL), I-League, Durand Cup, Super Cup
 
 

 Handball
